name: [🎅🏾] Watch Grass Grow Simulator
desc:
Turn a single patch of grass into a massive, money-making empire!

🌿 PLANT grass by LOOKING AT IT — an addictive incremental progression system perfect for AFK and idle play.
💸 SELL your crops for tons of cash!
🚀 UPGRADE to grow GIANT plants
🐶 HATCH cute pets that give you amazing boosts on your simulator adventure!
🔄 REBIRTH to unlock even more powerful pets
🤝 PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Compete to be #1 on the leaderboards and show everyone you're the ultimate farming master!

👍 Please like and favourite the game for more UPDATES
